parameters.name: DBInstanceCategories
parameters.description: The edition of the instance. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBInstanceIds
parameters.description: The instance ID. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBInstanceModes
parameters.description: The resource type of the instance. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceDeployTypes
parameters.description: This parameter is no longer used.

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC).
*   **Classic**: classic network.

> If you do not specify this parameter, instances of all network types are returned.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID. You can use this parameter to filter instances that reside in the specified VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-description gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --instance-network-type VPC --db-instance-ids gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 50 --page-number 1 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --instance-deploy-types example-string --db-instance-statuses running --db-instance-categories basic,highavailability --db-instance-modes storageelastic,serverless --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --vpc-id vpc-t4nqyp3tc5mx7vy60000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeDBInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'test-key' --PageSize 50 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DBInstanceStatuses running --InstanceNetworkType VPC --InstanceDeployTypes 'example-string' --DBInstanceModes 'storageelastic,serverless' --VpcId 'vpc-t4nqyp3tc5mx7vy60000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value 'test-value' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBInstanceIds 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --DBInstanceDescription 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --DBInstanceCategories 'basic,highavailability'
